messages:
jia: Heads-up — change window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. There's potential contention: API config flip + router header-split + runtime kernel bump. Need clear pin/rollback plan before we start.

deploybot: Scheduled change window recorded: 2026-03-23T23:00Z → 2026-03-24T01:00Z. Locks requested: api, runtime, router. Canary plan suggested in runbook. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/change-window

samir: Runtime note: kernel bump + quantized kernels applied in this version. Plan = canary 5% for 15m. If p95 latency regresses >200ms or token throughput drops >15% -> rollback. Also KV prefix cache will be invalidated; expect a small spike.

alex: Console team: we're planning the header UI flip at +30m. Prefer to hold flip until router+runtime are stable for at least 10m after canary completes. Otherwise console will show inconsistent routing.

maria: API team will pin to api-v2.6.0 for the window. If router isn't pinned at T0, we keep API on api-v2.5.9. Release notes draft: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-change-draft.md

jia: Actionables (short):
1) pin router + runtime before traffic shift
2) start 5% canary for 15m
3) evaluate metrics at +15m (errors, p95, qps)
4) console flip at +30m only if +10m stable after canary
5) rollback criteria documented below and owned

samir: Commands I'll run once we have thumbs: 
```
# pin artifacts
deployctl pin router=router-v2.6.0 runtime=runtime-v3.2.1
# start canary
deployctl canary --service router --pct 5 --duration 15m --notify #incidents
```

ops-bot: Alerting config updated: notify channels = #incidents, #eng-oncall. SLO guard set: error-rate >3% OR p95 latency +200ms => auto-signal for rollback. Auto-failover target: router-v2.5.9.

maria: Also remind infra: clear cache TTLs <2h before T0 OR set read-through fallback for 30m. Otherwise clients might see mixed prefixes.

release-bot: Publication: release note stub created at /docs/releases/2026-03-change-draft.md — please add the header-split caveat and canary timeline.

alex: Console: holding flip. I'll post "console: ready" once I observe router stable for 10m.

jia: Timeline recap: T0 = pin + canary start. T+15m = evaluate. T+30m = console flip if green. Rollback criteria repeated below for clarity.

samir: Rollback procedure (if criteria met):
```
# rollback router and runtime to last stable
deployctl rollback router --to router-v2.5.9
deployctl rollback runtime --to runtime-v3.2.0
# note: after rollback, we re-open old pins for API/console until confirmed
```

maria: Please add this line to release notes: "staged header-split; console flip delayed until runtime/router stability confirmed." I'll update after alex posts console: ready.

jia: Who's owning the decision at +15m? @samir you to call green/red? If red, samir executes rollback and pings ops.

samir: I own the go/no-go at +15m. I'll watch error-rate, p95, and TPS. If any guard trips, I execute rollback and post a short postmortem note in thread.

oncall: ack, I'll be watching dashboards for first 45m and ready to page if threshold hits.

jia: Thanks. Tagging @ops for extra eyes. :thumbsup: 

(End of thread)
